metadata.technology_specification: Benchtop flow cytometer with multi-laser excitation and multi-parameter detection
metadata.technology_reasoning: Benchtop flow cytometers with multiple laser sources and multi-parameter detectors are the industry standard widely adopted in clinical, research, and industrial labs for their versatility and capacity to analyze multiple cellular markers simultaneously, representing the dominant form in 2024.

components.reasoning: Core system for handling and hydrodynamically focusing samples, universally present as a separate assembly with complex supply requirements.
Multi-laser modules are standardized components providing excitation light sources; critical for fluorescence excitation, procured separately.
Includes photomultiplier tubes (PMTs) or avalanche photodiodes and corresponding optical filters; essential for detecting emitted fluorescence and scattered light.
Primary electronic boards responsible for signal amplification, data processing, and communication; distinct and standardized in manufacturing.
Distinct component for introducing sample into fluidics stream; common as a separately serviced module.
Includes display screens and control inputs, procured as separate assemblies in modern cytometers.
Component for collecting sample waste fluid, often modular but sometimes integrated; moderately confident as primary.
Structural framework housing all components, usually procured as a separate module to standardize assembly and service.
